trap.label: mandativo
trap.wrong: We propose that the school bans phones.
trap.right: We propose that the school ban phones.
trap.why: Em português “propomos que a escola proíba” usa subjuntivo, que o aluno traduz com -s. Em inglês, propose/urge/suggest that + base (sem -s).

mcq.q: “We propose that the council ___ the plan.”

opts: My opponent claims…, but in fact…
For these reasons, we urge you to…

fix.wrong: We propose that the team writes a report.
fix.right: We propose that the team write a report.

fix.wrong: My opponent claim that costs fell.
fix.right: My opponent claims that costs fell.

fix.wrong: We urge to vote for the proposition.
fix.right: We urge you to vote for the proposition.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com propose that: “We want the school to ban phones.” (We propose that…)
rewrite.answer: We propose that the school ban phones.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com urge: “Please vote yes.” (We urge you…)
rewrite.answer: We urge you to vote yes.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com claims: “My opponent says costs fell.”
rewrite.answer: My opponent claims that costs fell.
